common.title: Open Weights Capability Jump
common.line: An open-weight release lands within a few months of the closed frontier.

common.title: Taiwan Tension Rises
common.line: Extended military exercises, shipping insurance premiums rising, a diplomatic expulsion.

notable.title: Factory siting backlash
notable.line: Coordinated local opposition delays one or more AI factory shortlist sites, with municipal councils blocking grid pledges over energy prices and water use after grid-intrusion news links open models to vulnerability.

notable.title: Grid copycat extortion
notable.line: Criminal or copycat groups reuse tooling and techniques resembling the autumn grid intrusions for extortion attempts against municipal utilities and port operators, without state sponsorship.

notable.title: Siting backlash
notable.line: A coordinated municipal campaign across several host-candidate regions blocks AI factory site surveys over power prices and water use, forcing at least one shortlisted site to be withdrawn this turn.
